enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe regularly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Breathe deeply. Shift legs. Move arm under pillow. Turn again. Breathe in. Breathe out. Snore.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and morning hygiene routine
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face. Use toilet. Flush. Wash hands. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out bowl and pan. Crack eggs into bowl. Beat eggs. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Pour eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Place eggs on plate. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Eat eggs. Drink milk. Stand up. Place dishes in sink. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt and pants. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Look in mirror. Adjust collar. Pick up bag. Pack laptop. Zip bag. Walk out of bedroom.
Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at workstation. Greet colleagues. Check schedule. Pick up patient chart. Walk to patient room. Enter room. Wash hands. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Listen to heart. Administer medication. Record notes. Walk to next patient. Wash hands. Repeat patient care. Take break. Return to workstation.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and eating
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Choose food. Pay for food. Find table. Sit down. Eat food. Drink water. Talk to colleague. Stand up. Clear tray. Walk out of cafeteria.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Return to workstation. Check messages. Pick up patient chart. Walk to patient room. Wash hands. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Listen to heart. Administer medication. Record notes. Walk to next patient. Wash hands. Repeat patient care. Attend meeting. Take notes. Return to workstation.
Walk out of building. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk to house. Unlock door. Enter house.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out pot and pan. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Cook meat. Add vegetables. Stir. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Place dishes in sink. Walk out of kitchen.

Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Get snack. Return to couch. Sit down. Continue watching TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and personal hygiene
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Take off clothes. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse body. Wash hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Put on clothes. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Open computer. Turn on computer. Type on keyboard. Move mouse. Click. Read on screen. Type again. Open browser. Watch video. Close browser. Shut down computer. Stand up. Walk to bed. Sit on bed. Pick up book. Read book. Put down book. Lie down.

Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Breathe deeply. Turn again. Breathe in. Breathe out. Snore. Turn over. Adjust blanket. Sigh. Move legs.
